notes: Prompt Atelier V0.6.5 candidate: verified full ZIP backup and pre-update snapshot; persistent 60-second folder auto-monitoring while the workbench is open; browser heartbeat lifecycle shutdown; integrated analysis for 1–8 images with hash-verified source provenance; conservative structured material conflict detection. Approved AI history imports now preserve original prompt/media paths, source SHA-256 hashes, model, analysis ID and import time; case detail view exposes this provenance. Visual asset library now supports selecting multiple visible cases, bulk status changes, bulk tag addition, and confirmed bulk deletion. Failed saves roll back the in-memory state; deletions are retained in the existing per-asset revision history. Reusable prompt modules now support multi-select, bulk tag addition, and confirmed batch deletion with rollback on save failure. Case records now expose a dedicated product SKU/style-number field, include it in local keyword retrieval, and display it in result metadata; exact SKU lookup can now be populated through the normal case editor. Single-case edits and deletions now use UI-side rollback on failed persistence, matching the batch operation safety behavior. Fixed escaped template interpolation in smart case search results and exposed SKU in the case detail view. Case library now captures structured garment silhouette, fit, fabric composition, surface texture, construction details, craftsmanship, and generation constraints for richer retrieval and reuse. AI history analysis now classifies each input image by role (front/back/detail/fabric/label/scene/overall/unknown), preserves ordered per-image observations through human review and case import, and shows the classification in saved case details. Uncertain or missing roles remain explicitly marked for human review. AI history ingestion now extracts a structured outfit_items list (per garment/accessory category, name, color, material, silhouette, fit, details, evidence and bounded review score) plus evidence-backed outfit_relations. AI review and case details preview the breakdown; confirmed cases persist it, and the matcher can find an individual garment inside a complete outfit case. Uncertain item attributes remain review suggestions, not verified facts.
